subject.title: fix(whatsapp): cache bot's own outbound messages for quote metadata (#91445)

question: Should this WhatsApp Desktop rendering fix wait for redacted live Desktop/group proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate?
rationale: The patch is source-plausible and focused, but the reported failure is a real-client rendering issue that unit tests cannot prove.

options.title: Require Desktop Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live-output artifact from a real WhatsApp group/Desktop setup before merge.

options.title: Use Maintainer Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can independently validate the Desktop flow and explicitly mark the proof gate overridden.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked, or close it later if no real proof can be produced after the existing proof window matures.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live-output artifact from a real WhatsApp group/Desktop setup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and also authored adjacent echo-suppression behavior in the same WhatsApp send path.
